author: Avdol46
quote: I would've given it a 3, maybe a 4, because it's still a GTA game. But the truth is, this game is complete garbage. We waited more than 10 years for some woke BS. Half of the missions are basically chores or revolve around fixing a relationship. Lucia is annoying and useless, and the game runs at 30 FPS. WTF? This isn't GTA anymore. The franchise is officially dead. That's what happens when you let women develop a game made for men: they make it all about themselves. GTA 6 is just a girlfriend simulator.
